user.description: Configure access to the WD My Cloud API. Optional sleep-aware polling checks every disk over SSH and performs full API polls only for a confirmed wake phase or when the API interval is due. Power checks default to 10 seconds. The minimum API interval is {minimum_interval} seconds.

data_description.update_interval: Legacy polling interval, and the minimum spacing for periodic full API snapshots in sleep-aware mode. Does not control disk power checks.
data_description.power_probe_interval: Non-waking SSH probe using the selected method. Default and minimum 10 seconds.
data_description.sleep_aware_enabled: Requires SSH and the selected probe tool on the NAS. Unknown states block the WD API; confirmed Sleeping states remain visible.
data_description.ssh_password: Stored by Home Assistant. Use a dedicated credential where possible and restrict access to Home Assistant backups.
data_description.power_probe_method: hdparm preserves the existing default. smartctl (SAT) also recognizes IDLE_A/B/C and requires smartctl 7.2 or newer. Queries CHECK POWER MODE only, without SMART data or device-type autodetection.

error.invalid_drive_devices: Enter unique whole-disk paths separated by commas, for example /dev/sda,/dev/sdc. Partitions and shell commands are not allowed.
error.connection: Unable to connect to the server.
